name: Alpheus
overview: The Scriptures identify Alpheus primarily as the father of two of Jesus' disciples, James and Levi. James is mentioned as the son of Alphaeus among the twelve apostles, highlighting his role in the early church community. Levi, also called Matthew the publican, is noted as the son of Alphaeus whom Jesus called from his tax-collecting post to follow Him, demonstrating the transformative call of Christ to discipleship.
